title: StarsMC SMP
description: "StarsMC" is a Minecraft Survival Mode (SMP) server where cheating is prohibited, but there are no other additional rules to constrain you. You can do whatever you want.
body:
**StarsMC** - is a completely anarchic server where players have almost complete freedom, with few rules. Archives are not reset, and there are no rule restrictions. The world evolves entirely through player interaction
## **😎Features**
- **Few rules** - players can do anything, including but not limited to survival, raiding, and PvP
- **No cheating** - The server prohibits cheating to ensure fairness and justice for every player
- **Original gameplay** - minimal intervention in Minecraft gameplay
- **The world is for all** - trade unions, bases, and conflicts are all constructed by players

## **🐧community**
- This server has an official community on "**QQ**", with the  **[QQ:1038050711](https://qm.qq.com/q/pL5tNUXksw)**

## **🚀version**
**StarsMC** is a vanilla anarchy **SMP** for Minecraft **1.20–1.21.x.**
The server runs on 1.21.8, but supports clients from 1.20 all the way to 1.21.x.

## **🤔Why choose us:**
- **True anarchy survival**: No land claims, no strict moderation beyond anti-cheat.
- **Open PvP everywhere**: Fight, raid, and loot other players at any time.
- **Base raiding & griefing allowed**: Steal resources, destroy builds, and conquer territory.
- **Cross-version compatibility**: Join from **1.20–1.21.x** with no extra setup.
- **Only one enforced rule**: Cheating, hacked clients, and exploits are banned.

## **⭐What makes this server unique?**
- This is a world where trust is rare and danger is everywhere.
- Some players will offer help and friendship; others will betray, trap, raid, and dominate.
- There are no safe zones, no admin interference, and no hand-holding.

## **😘Why you should join:**
If you enjoy high-stakes survival challenges, player-driven conflicts, raids, and alliances between players
**StarsMC** is tailor-made for you, providing an intense multiplayer gaming experience.
Survive, form alliances, conquer or perish - the choice is yours.

## **🧐Note:**
This server is located in China
If you are located in a region outside Chinese Mainland, the delay is too high
Please use the overseas node **byd.starsmc.xin**
(This might be somewhat useful)
